name: Product Analysis
focus: Membandingkan dua atau lebih produk berdasarkan desain, fitur, spesifikasi, atau kemampuan untuk membantu audiens memahami perbedaannya.
image_prompt_elements: [{"element":"Subject & Product","priority":"Primary","details":["Identify every product, exact model, and variant being compared","Keep each product visually and textually distinct"]},{"element":"Action & Environment","priority":"Optional","details":["Use a contextual environment only when it clarifies a meaningful difference","Otherwise use a neutral comparison setting"]},{"element":"Composition","priority":"Primary","details":["Use balanced side-by-side, split-screen, or structured comparison layout","Align product views and information hierarchy","Make differences and shared characteristics easy to scan"]},{"element":"Visual Style","priority":"Secondary","details":["Use clean analytical infographic or editorial comparison styling","Keep decorative effects secondary to factual information"]},{"element":"Lighting","priority":"Secondary","details":["Keep lighting consistent across compared products","Avoid lighting differences that exaggerate or conceal product details"]},{"element":"Camera & Quality","priority":"Primary","details":["Maintain consistent scale, angle, perspective, and sharpness","Show comparable product details at equivalent visual prominence"]},{"element":"Color & Mood","priority":"Secondary","details":["Use neutral, distinguishable colors that support readability","Maintain an objective and fair presentation"]},{"element":"Text & Branding","priority":"Primary","details":["Show correct model names and verified specifications or feature labels","Clearly distinguish differences from shared features","Include relevant context such as model year or configuration when needed"]},{"element":"Negative Constraints","priority":"Always enforced","details":["Do not fabricate specifications or performance claims","Do not use unfair visual scaling or misleading product angles","Do not omit context that changes the meaning of a comparison","Do not alter product designs"]}]

name: Educational Content

image_prompt_elements: [{"element":"Subject & Product","priority":"Primary","details":["Identify the exact product, model, feature, app, or setting being explained","Specify the relevant interface or product area"]},{"element":"Action & Environment","priority":"Secondary","details":["Show the correct usage action or context when a demonstration is useful","Keep the demonstration consistent with the relevant device and software"]},{"element":"Composition","priority":"Primary","details":["Use a clear instructional hierarchy","Organize steps, callouts, close-ups, or diagrams logically","Make the sequence easy to scan on a mobile screen"]},{"element":"Visual Style","priority":"Secondary","details":["Use clean, accessible educational design","Keep infographic elements consistent and avoid unnecessary decoration"]},{"element":"Lighting","priority":"Secondary","details":["Ensure product details and demonstrations remain clearly visible","Avoid glare that obscures screens or controls"]},{"element":"Camera & Quality","priority":"Secondary","details":["Use close-up or screen-focused views where appropriate","Keep interface labels and product details sharp and legible"]},{"element":"Color & Mood","priority":"Secondary","details":["Use an approachable, calm palette","Maintain sufficient contrast for instructional clarity"]},{"element":"Text & Branding","priority":"Primary","details":["Include an accurate title, feature names, step labels, and concise instructions","Verify instructions against the relevant model and software version","Use concise language suitable for mobile viewing"]},{"element":"Negative Constraints","priority":"Always enforced","details":["Do not invent features or unsupported capabilities","Do not show incorrect steps or incompatible interfaces","Do not present outdated interface details as current","Avoid misleading diagrams and unreadable labels"]}]

image_prompt_elements: [{"element":"Subject & Product","priority":"Primary","details":["Show the relevant Apple product or ecosystem devices accurately","Define the people and product interaction required by the concept"]},{"element":"Action & Environment","priority":"Primary","details":["Describe a believable daily activity and product use case","Specify a relevant setting such as home, office, cafe, study space, or travel","Make interactions between people and devices natural"]},{"element":"Composition","priority":"Primary","details":["Use natural storytelling and editorial framing","Balance people, products, and environment","Keep the main activity and featured product easy to recognize"]},{"element":"Visual Style","priority":"Primary","details":["Authentic premium lifestyle editorial photography","Natural, contemporary, and believable visual treatment"]},{"element":"Lighting","priority":"Secondary","details":["Prefer natural or context-appropriate lighting","Preserve realistic skin tones and product appearance"]},{"element":"Camera & Quality","priority":"Secondary","details":["Use believable perspective and natural proportions","Maintain professional photographic detail and realistic depth of field"]},{"element":"Color & Mood","priority":"Primary","details":["Define a coherent palette and a clear mood such as calm, productive, warm, or aspirational","Keep the atmosphere natural rather than overly staged"]},{"element":"Text & Branding","priority":"Optional","details":["Add a short message or store identity only when the concept requires it","Do not let text interrupt the lifestyle story"]},{"element":"Negative Constraints","priority":"Always enforced","details":["Avoid unnatural hands, anatomy, or facial features","Avoid implausible device interactions or incorrect product appearance","Do not imply unsupported product or lifestyle benefits"]}]
